description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git checkout behavior, containing setup routines and various test cases for different checkout scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and verifies the outcomes.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates a timestamp or commit tick, used for ordering commits in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares file contents and verifies they are identical.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs specific tools or commands, such as changing file modification times.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
